name: The Psychologist
source:
Zaryansk. 

Adamo is dying. Something has been living inside him — regulating his fear, curating his reality, keeping him calm enough to be useful. It calls itself his Psychologist.

Over a single evening, Adamo and Mira — two strangers at the edge of death — are brought together by arrangements neither of them made.

A kinetic visual novel told through Italian fumetto noir comic panels and post-soviet music.
